challenge.method: Tested a reading that covers every file at the commit and every executable linked with a modified Core System. Checked the opening notice against LGPL clauses 2 and 6 and the later example notice.
challenge.results: The opening definition requires the INRIA marking. A modified Core System qualifies as publicly distributed under the notice when distributed under clause 2. The exception removes additional clause 6 requirements in the stated circumstances and preserves other grounds for LGPL coverage. The later 'or any later version' wording is an example for new libraries. The project's own opening notice specifies version 2.1.
